title: Pure Gorgonic
summary: Gorgonic together with the Umbral Horrors that its newest card, Gorgonic Umbral Horror, was made to fetch, plus generic staples. The older Chronomaly, Adamancipator and Reptilianne engines the page mentions are left out. Gorgonic Umbral Horror summons itself and searches an Umbral Horror, V Umbral Horror searches the rest and ranks Number 104: Masquerade up into the C104s, and Gorgonic Umbral Horror and Shining Umbral Horror each count as two materials for those Numbers. Gorgonic Umbral Horror limits the Extra Deck to Number Xyz Monsters.

allow.Barian's Seventh Untopia: The Field Spell Thousand Umbral Horror places; it searches an Umbral Horror monster each turn.

main: Gorgonic Umbral Horror
Newest support. Summons itself when you control no monsters or only Umbral Horrors and searches a non-Rock Umbral Horror; counts as two materials for a big Number Xyz.
V Umbral Horror
Newest support. Summoned: searches another Umbral Horror; from the GY, ranks a Masquerade Xyz up into a Number one Rank higher.
Shining Umbral Horror
Newest support. Summons itself when an Umbral Horror or Masquerade Xyz arrives and draws; counts as two Number materials.
Thousand Umbral Horror
Newest support. Sends itself to place Barian's Seventh Untopia; comes back from the GY when an Xyz is summoned.
Umbral Horror Ghost
Summons itself and a Level 4 or lower Fiend from the hand.
Umbral Horror Ghoul
Drops to 0 ATK to summon a 0-ATK Umbral Horror from the hand.
Umbral Horror Unform
Destroyed attacking: summons two Umbral Horrors from the Deck.
Umbral Horror Will o' the Wisp
Copies another Umbral Horror's Level on summon.
Gorgonic Gargoyle
Special Summons itself when you Normal Summon a Rock.
Gorgonic Ghoul
Pays 300 LP to summon another copy next to itself.
Gorgonic Cerberus
Normal Summoned: makes your Rocks Level 3 for Gorgonic Guardian.
Gorgonic Golem
Zeroes the monster that destroys it; from the GY, locks a Set card.
Barian's Seventh Untopia
Field Spell: searches an Umbral Horror and discards; limits the opponent's non-Number Extra Deck summons.
extra: Rank 4 for three Level 4s (Gorgonic or Shining Umbral Horror count as two): negates monster effects in the Battle Phase and mills a card.
Number C104: Umbral Horror Masquerade Victory
Newest support. Rank 5 that V Umbral Horror ranks up into: destroys a card and wins its battles.
Rank 5: destroys a Spell/Trap on arrival, and negates monster effects with Masquerade as material.
Rank 3 for two Level 3 Rocks: zeroes and negates a monster, then destroys it.
